caption: The drawing shows two views of a brown jug made of ceramic or similar material, placed on a wooden surface against a light, neutral background. The jug is cylindrical with a rounded shoulder, a narrow neck, and a small spout at the top; one view shows the jug from the front, and the other from the side. The jug is decorated with human facial features modeled in relief, including a prominent nose, lips, two eyes, and protruding ears. The front view shows the symmetrical placement of the features, while the side view reveals a single handle attached from the rim of the spout to the shoulder and provides a profile of the facial details. The surface of the jug is uniformly colored in a medium to dark brown glaze. The wooden surface has a yellowish-brown hue with visible wood grain lines. The overall composition is balanced, with each perspective of the jug occupying half of the drawing.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
